video_title: LeBron James and Steve Nash's 2026-27 NBA Season Preview

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James addresses Ant's comments about his age and knees
quotes.excerpt: I don't watch anything from the Stripes. Love Ant to death, but I don't watch shit from the Stripes.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: How did you feel about Ant calling you out and saying you're too old and your knees need to be cold, just to kick the season off the right way?

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: First of all, I did not watch the spot because I don't watch anything from the Stripes. I love Ant to death, but I don't watch shit from the Stripes. I don't even know what he actually said. You can see some of the headlines, like he said I'm too old, he ain't want his knees to be cold. But then I was like, I went to Philly, Ant. My knees are going to be warmer in Philly. He didn't edit some writing. He just read off the teleprompter. Clickbaity. He just read off the teleprompter.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the difficulty of tracking NBA free agency
quotes.excerpt: It's been a lot of movement this offseason. This time of year is the hardest time of year.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: Do you know where everyone else is this year?

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: I was just talking about this with a friend yesterday. I think I do, but if I mess up on one, it's not my fault. It's been a lot of movement this offseason. This time of year is the hardest time of year because free agency is in July. People find new homes when we're doing other things, and then a month or two pass, and now we're like, where is he at again? And then there's always a handful of guys that are still free agents but get signed under the radar, and you don't get the update, and then you see them on media day doing the photos, and you're like, oh shit, I didn't know. You see them in a uniform, and you're like, I didn't know, when did he sign there?

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James and Steve Nash discuss the New York Knicks' championship
quotes.excerpt: They earned the respect. They have a group of guys that when there's something on the table, they want it.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: Let's start with the Knicks. Let's give them their respect. They earned the respect. They also won the in-season tournament.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: They earned the respect. They have a group of guys that when there's something on the table, they want it. They go after it. They have a bunch of guys that can compete, and they got winners. One thing about Mike Brown's teams, and I played for coach for my years in my early days in Cleveland, one thing he always talked about was competing. Let's compete. Let's compete. Let's compete.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the evolution of Jalen Brunson's role
quotes.excerpt: He not only bought in, played off the hub, the offense became a little more egalitarian, a little less predictable.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: You remember early in the year, Cat made a comment about not being sure what he's doing this offense. But by the end of the year, he not only bought in, played off the hub, the offense became a little more egalitarian, a little less predictable, and he defended.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: And that goes back to episode one about trial and error. He had some trial and error. He was out there like, I feel like a blind bat right now. I don't know what I'm doing. I'm just out here. I trail, shoot my three off the trail spot, I may get a post-up, I don't know what I'm doing. And they had that trial and error run, and we saw what happened from the moment, obviously, when he said that, to them hosting the Larry O'Brien trophy.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James praises Jalen Brunson's performance in the finals
quotes.excerpt: I think was the MVP of the team in the finals. The small things, the chase down block on Fox.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: Obviously, we see OG. OG was, I think was the MVP of the team in the finals. And obviously, Brunson became the MVP, but it's the small things, the chase down block on Fox, the tip for the game. He was the consistent to continue to knock down threes. And his numbers from the day one of the playoffs through was incredible in those pivotal moments.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: And his numbers from the day one of the playoffs through was incredible in those pivotal moments.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on Jalen Brunson's leadership and endurance
quotes.excerpt: He got his team over the line, clutch moments, leadership, guarded his yard the best he could.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: Jalen Brunson, we talk questions about can a small guard, having been one myself and not been able to get over the hump, he got his team over the line, clutch moments, leadership, guarded his yard the best he could, never made excuses, never cut corners. And that type of endurance, stamina, willpower, a clutch gene, I want to give him a lot of props for just an incredible run leading that team.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: Absolutely, absolutely.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on the Oklahoma City Thunder's potential
quotes.excerpt: Without Jalen Williams being healthy, they still took it to seven and was injured like a lot.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: Oklahoma City, probably my pick to win it last year, ran into, I think an incredible, obviously, San Antonio and Victor Wembanyama and those great guards and all that. Having said that, they were injured. So I think you have to say without Jalen Williams being healthy, they still took it to seven, and was injured like a lot. I think you could say the same for, gosh, I'm getting my C-legs here, the guard, Mitchell. Mitchell, who's turned into a terrific player, too, and is going to be, both of those guys obviously, but Mitchell is going to be super important this year because they lost Dort, Isaiah Joe, Aaron Wiggins.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: Oh yeah, yeah, yeah, Mitchell. Yeah, Mitchell.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on the Thunder's cap flexibility and roster changes
quotes.excerpt: They had some real cap flexibility issues and they wanted to be able to move forward.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: If they are healthy, what do you think of their additions? Because part of that thing is that they had some real cap flexibility issues and they wanted to be able to move forward and keep this team in the best position they could, which meant shedding some of these guys that are terrific players, important players.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: I think it's very important that we as fans of the game and the casuals don't write off OKC just yet. You're so intrigued with obviously with Victor and rightfully so, and with what they bring to the table and obviously the young guys, Jalen Harper, you love what they bring to the game, and I love watching those guys. They're unbelievable. But we're quick to turn the page a lot faster than when we should.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on the Thunder's future and Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: We see this team with Shai still in his prime, Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren, still have a lot of ground.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: We see this team with Shai still in his prime, Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren, still have a lot of ground to get, is this creature named Wembanyama. That's the only thing that makes anyone think like, oh, because they're time done, but the reality is they went to seven games, not completely healthy.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: I wouldn't mind seeing OKC and San Antonio again in the Western Conference Finals.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash and LeBron James on the San Antonio Spurs
quotes.excerpt: Is this Wembanyama's MVP year? I mean, I don't see why not.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: Moving to the Spurs, I mean, is this Wembanyama's MVP year?

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: I mean, I don't see why not.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: Yeah, exactly. I mean, you could make the case last year. I'll break it down. In my eyes, Wembanyama had a case for MVP last year because of the totality of how he affects the game. I think the difference is that we traditionally, you look at who closed the game for your team. And Wembanyama can close games, but he doesn't, he's not necessarily the closer yet. He can close some nights, some nights it's not his thing.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on the Minnesota Timberwolves' roster changes
quotes.excerpt: They added LaMelo Ball, Jonathan Kuminga. They lost Julius Randle, Naz Reid, Kyle Anderson.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: Moving into some of these teams that are next most exciting, Minnesota. Look, they've made conference, the last three conference finals. They add LaMelo Ball, Jonathan Kuminga. They lost Julius Randle, Naz Reid, Kyle Anderson.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: I think it's going to be interesting. I mean, obviously, we know what LaMelo what he brings to the game, his ability to pass, his shot making ability. They felt like they needed a little bit more attack at the point guard position, playmaking at the point guard position.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on Jonathan Kuminga's potential with the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: Obviously Kuminga is super intriguing. Obviously we see it didn't work out in Golden State.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: Obviously Kuminga is super intriguing. Obviously we see it didn't work out in Golden State, but when he played well, when he got the opportunity, he was able to showcase what he what he can do. So, I do think, you know, they lost a lot of bit of their their their bulk in the interior, losing Naz and losing Julius. And this is a team who over the past few years kind of like to beat you up, you know, and Naz and and and Julius gave them a little bit of that of that muscle.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: Yeah, for sure.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on the Timberwolves' need for a faster pace
quotes.excerpt: Can LaMelo push and run a little more? You got Kuminga. Now you can play a little more.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: Can LaMelo push and run a little more? You got Kuminga. Now you can play a little more of feeling a little bit more of like this athletic speed pressure based team, over the, you know, they had more physicality and try to beat you up. So it'd be interesting to see how much Coach Finch changes their identity towards playing a little faster, playing a little more athletic. How that works. I think Rudy really played well last year and improved.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: Yeah, I think you're right that the backcourt will work.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on the Miami Heat's acquisition of Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: The Miami Heat, obviously one of the biggest transactions, trade for Giannis Antetokounmpo, pairing Giannis and Bam.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: The Miami Heat, obviously one of the biggest transactions, trade for Giannis Antetokounmpo, Tim Hardaway Jr., Klay Thompson, Bobby Portis. They lost Tyler Herro, Jaime Jaquez Jr., Norm Powell, Kel'el Ware. What are your initial thoughts?

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: My initial thoughts is going to be damn good. Obviously, we seen what Bam has been able to do over the last few seasons. He's actually started to shoot the three a lot more. Pivotal to to giving, we know what Giannis, he needs space. He wants space. He creates space.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the defensive potential of the new-look Heat
quotes.excerpt: I think defensively they're going to be damn good. You look at Wiggins, you look at Bam, you look at Giannis.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: I think defensively they're going to be damn good. You look at Wiggins, you look at Bam, you look at Giannis, you look at Davion Mitchell, you know, guys that that's where they they kind of hang their hats on. They're going to be damn good. And, you know, when you have Spo there, Spo is always going, he's going, he knows how to put the pieces in the right position and the right place.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: Yeah, absolutely.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on the Indiana Pacers' outlook with Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese gets hurt in the game seven of the finals. Just to remember for context, on fire early.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: Let's move on to the Pacers. So, Tyrese gets hurt in the game seven of the finals. Just to remember for context, on fire early, and for really one of the greatest stories in sports, I think that team that came sort of from nowhere to take a terrific OKC team to seven, lose Tyrese for a year in game seven, a game in which he started out making halacious threes.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: Yeah, exactly.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on the Pacers' roster moves and team identity
quotes.excerpt: The biggest change obviously for them is the Miles Turner was on that team and now you have Zoo.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: The biggest change obviously for them is the Miles Turner was on that team and now you have Zoo. Who's terrific. I think some people say, yeah, but Miles space the floor, Zoo doesn't do that, but I think Zubac is such an intelligent player. He's greater on the basket, both ends of the floor. I think his screening off the ball to create space can be a different look than just Miles spacing the floor.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: I think they're a very interesting, very interesting and intriguing group of teams.

quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on the importance of shooting for the Hawks
quotes.excerpt: Shooting is going to be important for them, obviously. Dort's got to shoot them on.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: Shooting is going to be important for them, obviously. Dort's got to shoot them on. And to be fair, Lu Dort has great numbers catching shoot on the perimeter. It's a matter of like when push comes to shove and people leave him, will he make the shot?

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: Yeah, they got a lot of guys.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on his admiration for Penny Hardaway
quotes.excerpt: When I saw him play, I was like, oh my goodness, this guy is different. Behind the back passes.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: When I saw him play, I was like, oh my goodness, this guy is different. Behind the back passes, you know, between the legs, he was shifting, cross dribbles, doing things that I was like, these, this guy is, this guy is different. Yeah, he really was different. He was bouncy, too. Right, and he was bouncy, too. He was jitterbuggy for a 6'8, I don't know, 6'7, 6'8. Yeah, like I was a Michael Jordan fanatic, and my brother, not my blood brother, but like my guy who I grew up with, actually Brandon Williams, who became the new GM of the Cavs last week, shout out to you, B Williams. He spoke the gospel about Penny Hardaway, and he actually was the one who like got me into Penny Hardaway.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: I'm similar in MJ. You know, I was probably the very end of Magic Bird.
